name: swmm5-rust: SWMM 5 in safe Rust
description: Runs EPA SWMM 5.2.4, translated into safe Rust by swmm5-rust, inside RustGIS's plugin sandbox, and adds the model's subcatchments, links, nodes and rain gages as layers whose attributes are the engine's own summary results. Runs in the desktop app, on the command line and in the web app.
author: Robert Dickinson (SWMM Enablement), with Claude

commands.label:
About
Engine
commands.help: Which SWMM engine and build this plugin carries.

tools.name: Run SWMM 5 Model
tools.summary: Runs a SWMM 5 .inp file with swmm5-rust and adds its network as layers with the run's summary results.

params.name: model
params.label: SWMM 5 input file
params.help: The model's .inp file. Files it names (rainfall, inflows, hotstart) go in the data file boxes below; inside the sandbox nothing else can be read.

params.name: epsg
params.label: Model coordinate system (EPSG code)
params.help: The EPSG code of the model's map coordinates, such as 3435 (NAD83 / Illinois East, US feet). RustGIS reprojects the layers if it knows the code; if not, it says so and reads them as longitude/latitude. Esri's six-digit codes (102xxx) are not EPSG codes. Blank: [MAP] UNITS Degrees is read as longitude/latitude, anything else is drawn at true size around the point below.

params.name: anchor_lon
params.label: Local frame: center longitude
params.help: Where to draw a model that has no real coordinates.

params.name: anchor_lat
params.label: Local frame: center latitude
params.help: Where to draw a model that has no real coordinates.

params.name: data1
params.label: Data file the model names (1)
params.help: A rainfall, inflow, hotstart or other file the .inp names. It is found by its own name (in any case), whatever folder the .inp gives; the run's messages say which file stood in for which name.

params.label: Data file the model names (2)
params.help: A rainfall, inflow, hotstart or other file the .inp names. It is found by its own name (in any case), whatever folder the .inp gives; the run's messages say which file stood in for which name.
